background_setting: A two-lane rural highway cutting through open countryside under a clear blue daytime sky. Flat to gently rolling fields of dry golden and green grass line both shoulders, with scattered low trees and utility poles marching along the roadside. The asphalt is grey with a faded yellow centre line and white edge markings. Distant hills and a flat horizon complete the setting, with the road extending straight ahead into the distance.

lighting.illumination_effect: high contrast, well-lit scene with strong glare off the white blade and clear visibility of the road ahead

context: Automotive driving-hazard scenario depicting an ego vehicle failing to react to an encroaching oversize load

actions.description: Ego car cruises down the centre of its lane; the escort vehicle with flashing amber lights and the oversize-load truck appear ahead in the oncoming lane. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The convoy grows larger; the huge white wind-turbine blade is seen overhanging the centre line and jutting into the ego lane. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle continues at unchanged cruising speed straight down the middle of its lane as the blade overhang looms dangerously close, showing no braking or evasion. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego car cruises down a sunny two-lane rural highway, fields on either side, the road stretching straight ahead. By 0:01 an escort pickup with flashing amber lights appears in the oncoming lane, an 'OVERSIZE LOAD' banner visible, followed by a large flatbed truck. At 0:02 the convoy is close enough to reveal an enormous glossy white wind-turbine blade whose tip overhangs the yellow centre line and protrudes into the ego lane. From 0:03 to 0:05 the ego vehicle continues at its steady cruising speed, centered in its lane, making no attempt to brake or move over as the blade looms dangerously near, ending with the overhang perilously close. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
